pub.how.title: From search to delivery, step by step.
pub.how.lead: Here is the real journey of a request in counter., between the patient, the platform and the pharmacy.
pub.how.s1t: The patient searches for the medicine
pub.how.s1: They type a name (even with a typo) and see nearby pharmacies that have it in stock, as a list and on the map.
pub.how.s2t: They choose a pharmacy and send the request
pub.how.s2: The choice is free. A prescription medicine needs a valid prescription (the patient’s statement) or a confirmed request from their doctor.
pub.how.s3: Only the chosen pharmacy receives the request. It has 30 minutes to answer; if it refuses or does not answer, the patient chooses another pharmacy.
pub.how.s4t: It prepares the order, the patient pays online
pub.how.s4: Once the request is accepted, the patient can pay online (test mode, no real payment). The pharmacist checks the prescription before preparing.
pub.how.s5: Accepted, preparing, ready, out for delivery (simulated), delivered: tracking updates by itself.
pub.how.doctorsText: A verified doctor can prepare a request for a patient who confirmed the link. The request reaches no pharmacy until the patient chooses one. The doctor never sees the patient’s address.
pub.how.pharmaciesText: A verified pharmacy keeps its stock up to date. It is proposed only if it is active, not paused and has everything in stock. It sees only the requests sent to it, with the patient shown as "First L.".

pub.about.title: A prototype to bring patients and pharmacies closer.
pub.about.lead: counter. is a demonstration project. It shows how a modern service can help find a medicine nearby without becoming an online pharmacy.
pub.about.mission: When a medicine is short, people go from pharmacy to pharmacy. counter. shows where it is in stock and lets the patient choose, keeping the pharmacist at the centre.
pub.about.honestTitle: What is real and what is not
pub.about.real: Real in the demo: search, map, requests, pharmacy choice, dashboards, tracking, prescription and privacy rules.
pub.about.notReal: Not built yet: real couriers, real payments (payment is in test mode), HDS-certified hosting, real prescription verification, legal review.
pub.about.v1: Only pharmacies sell; we only connect.
pub.about.v3: Everything simulated is labelled as such.

pub.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
pub.faq.lead: Short answers to the questions we hear most.
pub.faq.a1: No. It is a demonstration prototype with fictional data. Do not use it for a real medical need.
pub.faq.q2: Can I order medicines online here?
pub.faq.a2: No. counter. sells nothing: you send a request to the pharmacy you choose, and it sells. The demo’s online payment is in test mode, with no real money.
pub.faq.a3: By you. We show verified pharmacies that take requests and have everything in stock; you choose.
pub.faq.a4: You need your prescription statement or a confirmed request from your doctor. The pharmacist checks before preparing.
pub.faq.q5: How long does the pharmacy have to answer?
pub.faq.a5: 30 minutes. If it refuses or does not answer, you choose another pharmacy. If no pharmacy answers, the request expires after 24 hours.
pub.faq.a6: No, it is simulated: the courier on the map is an animation.
pub.faq.q7: What does the pharmacy see about me?
pub.faq.a7: Only the requests you send to it, with your first name and the initial of your last name.
pub.faq.a8: Only if you confirmed the link. They never see your address.
pub.faq.a9: This is a prototype: do not enter any real data. Certified hosting for health data (HDS) is not in place. You can export or delete your account at any time.
pub.faq.q10: How do a pharmacy or a doctor join?
pub.faq.a10: By creating a professional account (FINESS or RPPS). Our team verifies it before it can be used.
pub.legal.banner: Demonstration text, not legally reviewed. The site is a prototype with fictional data.
pub.privacy.title: Privacy
pub.privacy.lead: What the demo stores, who can see it and what you can do.
pub.privacy.p1: counter. is a demonstration prototype. The contact details shown are fictional. It is not a health service.
pub.privacy.p2: Your account (email, name, role, hashed password), your requests and orders, your preferences (language, notifications) and messages sent through the contact form. Do not enter any real data, especially no health data.
pub.privacy.p3: Patients see their own data. A pharmacy sees only the requests it was chosen for, with "First L.". A doctor sees only patients who confirmed the link, never their address. Staff view for moderation and never act as you.
pub.privacy.p4: No advertising cookies or trackers. Your browser keeps your session and preferences (language, theme, graphics quality).
pub.privacy.p5: From "My account" you can export your data and delete your account. For any question, use the contact form.
pub.terms.title: Terms of use
pub.terms.lead: The prototype’s rules, in plain words.
pub.terms.p1: counter. connects patients, doctors and pharmacies. It is a demonstration: no medical advice, no sales.
pub.terms.p2: Only pharmacies sell. counter. passes on requests and is not a party to the sale. The demo’s payments are in test mode.
pub.terms.p3: Doctor and pharmacy accounts are verified by staff before use. You are responsible for keeping your password secret.
pub.terms.p4: Delivery and payments are simulated; real prescription verification is not in place.
pub.terms.p5: The prototype is provided as is, for demonstration. Do not use it for a real medical need.

This prototype is not hosted with a certified health-data host: do not enter any real data.
